Cause and effects are separated through canal dumping. Evaluation checks implementation and harm reduction. Climate teaching explains warming, ecosystem impacts, economic/social/policy effects, and evidence-to-action framework planning.

Evidence is required before attributing pollution. Weather is distinguished from climate; local flood factors and overlapping effects are noted. Adaptation and mitigation labels depend on main purpose and can overlap.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: Look for the harmful practice, its likely source, and who or what is affected.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Teaches a systematic source, practice, and affected-party check.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: Government responses include rules, permits, inspections, public services, and action against violations.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Response mechanisms are explained and applied in local cases.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: Climate change can harm ecosystems by changing the conditions that plants and animals need.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Teaches ecological, water, coastal, farm, and human effects.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: Governments choose climate laws, budgets, land-use rules, and projects.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Explains policy choices and government coordination with a worked case.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: Drought can reduce a harvest and farm earnings.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Connects climate effects to production, income, property, and costs.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: Flooding can force families to move and keep children out of school.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Teaches displacement, health, schooling, and recovery inequality.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: The framework considers vulnerability, adaptation needs, and ways to reduce emissions.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Contents and application are present; statutory confirmation remains separate.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: The barangay needs collection and handling that support the sorting done by households.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Works an implementation failure and teaches evidence-based effectiveness checks.
